events.name: New York Rangers at New York Islanders

headlines.description: — David Rittich made 27 saves for his ninth career shutout, Anders Lee scored less than a minute into the game, and the New York Islanders blanked the New York Rangers 2-0 on Saturday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Lee scores early, Rittich makes 27 saves in Islanders 2-0 win over Rangers

headlines.description: — Mattias Samuelsson had a goal and two assists as the Buffalo Sabres beat the Boston Bruins 4-1 on Saturday night for their eighth straight victory.
headlines.shortLinkText: Samuelsson's three-point game leads Sabres to 8th straight win, 4-1 over Bruins

events.name: Ottawa Senators at Toronto Maple Leafs

headlines.description: — Captain Auston Matthews shook off a slump with a goal and two assists, and Matthew Knies scored twice to lead the Toronto Maple Leafs to a 7-5 win against the Ottawa Senators on Saturday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Auston Matthews has goal, 2 assists as Maple Leafs beat Senators 7-5

events.name: Tampa Bay Lightning at Florida Panthers

headlines.description: — Pontus Holmberg scored with 7.3 seconds left in the first period to put Tampa Bay on top for good, Nikita Kucherov scored twice and the Lightning beat the Florida Panthers 4-2 in another penalty-filled matchup between the Sunshine State rivals.
headlines.shortLinkText: Kucherov scores twice, Lightning top Panthers 4-2 in another penalty-filled matchup

events.name: Washington Capitals at New Jersey Devils

headlines.description: — Defenseman Jakob Chychrun scored in overtime and Logan Thompson made 35 saves as the Washington Capitals beat the New Jersey Devils 4-3 on Saturday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Chychrun scores in overtime to lift Capitals past Devils 4-3

events.name: Detroit Red Wings at Carolina Hurricanes

headlines.description: — Shayne Gostisbehere and Andrei Svechnikov each had a goal and two assists and the Carolina Hurricanes snapped a season-worst three-game skid with a 5-2 win over the Detroit Red Wings on Saturday night in a matchup of divisional leaders.
headlines.shortLinkText: Gostisbehere, Svechnikov post 3-point games as Hurricanes beat Red Wings 5-2, end 3-game skid

headlines.description: — Matt Boldy scored two goals, including the winner just 39 seconds into overtime, to lead the Minnesota Wild to a 4-3 come-from-behind victory over the Winnipeg Jets on Saturday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Boldy scores in OT as Wild rally to beat Jets 4-3

events.name: Nashville Predators at St. Louis Blues

headlines.description: — Pavel Buchnevich scored twice, Brayden Schenn had a goal for his 700th career point, and the St. Louis Blues beat the Nashville Predators 3-2 on Saturday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Blues beat Predators 3-2 as Buchnevich scores twice

headlines.description: — Rookie Nick Lardis scored in the fourth round of the shootout to give the Chicago Blackhawks a 4-3 win over the Dallas Stars on Saturday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: NHL-worst Blackhawks snap 6-game skid with a 4-3, shootout victory over the Stars

events.name: Anaheim Ducks at Los Angeles Kings

headlines.description: — Alex Laferriere scored three times and the Los Angeles Kings finally found their offense in a 6-1 win over the Anaheim Ducks on Saturday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Alex Laferriere nets hat trick as Kings end scoring funk in 6-1 win over Ducks

headlines.description: — Blake Coleman scored his 11th goal of the season with 7:29 to play and the Calgary Flames edged the Edmonton Oilers 3-2 on Saturday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Blake Coleman scores late as Flames edge Oilers 3-2

events.name: San Jose Sharks at Vancouver Canucks

headlines.description: — Macklin Celebrini had a goal and an assist in a return to his hometown, powering the San Jose Sharks past the Vancouver Canucks 6-3 on Saturday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Celebrini gets goal and assist in return home as Sharks top Canucks 6-3 to stop 3-game slide

events.name: Colorado Avalanche at Vegas Golden Knights

headlines.description: — Martin Necas scored two goals in regulation and another during the shootout and the Colorado Avalanche beat the Vegas Golden Knights 6-5 on Saturday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Necas scores twice, MacKinnon gets shootout winner, Avs top Knights 6-5
